crossRefs.note: Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it.
Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from…
He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of Yahweh to…

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Negeb
people.line: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area

people.name: Shephelah
people.line: Lowland region between Judean hills and coastal plain

translations.web: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.
translations.bsb: Afterward, the men of Judah marched down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, in the Negev, and in the foothills.
translations.kjv: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.
translations.asv: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites that dwelt in the hill-country, and in the South, and in the lowland.
